hooks.command: echo '=== task.md — start-of-session review ==='; cat task.md 2>/dev/null || echo '(task.md not found)'; echo; echo '=== action_items.md — start-of-session review ==='; cat action_items.md 2>/dev/null || echo '(action_items.md not found)'

echo '{"systemMessage":"Anti-slop check: no generic placeholders, no TODO comments, no filler copy, no invented values. Every change must be purposeful and match the existing code style. If unsure, read the file first."}'
p=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$p" in */task.md|task.md) python3 scripts/workflow_state.py on-task-updated 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac
